The Archangel · уровень 14

You fully embody heaven’s executioner, becoming the
Archangel’s perfected vessel. While in your Avatar of the
Archangel form, you gain the following benefits:
• You shed Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim
Light for another 60 feet.
• You have Resistance to all damage except Force.
• When you hit a creature with an attack, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.
• You always know the direction and distance to any creature you have damaged since the start of this transformation.
You can now expend a Pact Magic spell slot (no action required) to restore your use of Avatar of the Archangel.

Автоматизация / ограничения:

  • Сопротивления формы применяет макрос; телепортация, слежение и восстановление за Pact slot — вручную.

source.custom: Legends of the Round Table: Chivalric Handbook
